title: There Are No Intact Eggs Under an Overturned Nest
synopsis: Eggs are beautiful but also very fragile—if their nest is knocked over, they will surely break. In this lesson, a precocious nine-year-old from the Eastern Han dynasty uses this image to teach us a timeless truth about how our fates are closely intertwined with the people around us.

fullText.simplified:
覆巢之下无完卵

    作为一种常见的食物，鸡蛋是人们餐桌上的常客。与蛋相关的俗语在汉语中也是十分常见，“覆巢之下无完卵”就是其中之一。
    在东汉末年，权力逐渐落到了曹操手中。为此，很多人反对他、批评他，孔融就是反对派的重要代表之一。曹操认为有人反对自己是很正常的事情，而且他也希望人们看到自己宽容的样子，所以对孔融的批评表现得不太在意。孔融在当时很有影响力，但性格上有一个缺点——说话太直接，这让一些人很讨厌孔融。一天，孔融在背后说了曹操的坏话，被一个讨厌孔融的人听到了。这个人就向曹操报告，还增加了一些难听的话，说孔融瞧不起曹操等等。曹操听了大怒，下令杀掉孔融全家。
    很快，曹操的手下就来到孔融家抓人。孔融的家人都害怕极了，求曹操放了他们。只有孔融的两个孩子，一个八岁，一个九岁，还坐在那里下棋，一点害怕的样子都没有。大家以为孩子小，不懂事，就让他们赶紧逃走，但两个孩子还像没听到一样，继续下棋。孔融心疼极了，对曹操的人说：“我的孩子还太小，只是我犯了错，能不能别杀这两个孩子？”没想到，孔融的儿子慢慢走上前，平静地说：“父亲，您别求他了。您在翻倒的鸟窝下能看到完整的蛋吗？”大家听完都吃惊极了，原来这两个小孩什么都明白。
    这就是“覆巢之下无完卵”的故事。“覆巢”就是翻倒的鸟窝，“完卵”就是完整的蛋。这一俗语的字面意思就是翻倒的鸟窝里不会有完整的蛋，真正的意思是集体遇到麻烦时，个体也难以避开麻烦。
    对于当代人来说，全球化让我们的生活更方便更自由，但也让世界各地普遍产生联系。因此，我们可以说：“面对全球经济危机，覆巢之下无完卵”。
fullText.traditional:
覆巢之下無完卵

    作為一種常見的食物，雞蛋是人們餐桌上的常客。與蛋相關的俗語在漢語中也是十分常見，“覆巢之下無完卵”就是其中之一。
    在東漢末年，權力逐漸落到了曹操手中。為此，很多人反對他、批評他，孔融就是反對派的重要代表之一。曹操認為有人反對自己是很正常的事情，而且他也希望人們看到自己寬容的樣子，所以對孔融的批評表現得不太在意。孔融在當時很有影響力，但性格上有一個缺點——說話太直接，這讓一些人很討厭孔融。一天，孔融在背後說了曹操的壞話，被一個討厭孔融的人聽到了。這個人就向曹操報告，還增加了一些難聽的話，說孔融瞧不起曹操等等。曹操聽了大怒，下令殺掉孔融全家。
    很快，曹操的手下就來到孔融家抓人。孔融的家人都害怕極了，求曹操放了他們。只有孔融的兩個孩子，一個八歲，一個九歲，還坐在那裡下棋，一點害怕的樣子都沒有。大家以為孩子小，不懂事，就讓他們趕緊逃走，但兩個孩子還像沒聽到一樣，繼續下棋。孔融心疼極了，對曹操的人說：“我的孩子還太小，只是我犯了錯，能不能別殺這兩個孩子？”沒想到，孔融的兒子慢慢走上前，平靜地說：“父親，您別求他了。您在翻倒的鳥窩下能看到完整的蛋嗎？”大家聽完都吃驚極了，原來這兩個小孩什麼都明白。
    這就是“覆巢之下無完卵”的故事。“覆巢”就是翻倒的鳥窩，“完卵”就是完整的蛋。這一俗語的字面意思就是翻倒的鳥窩裡不會有完整的蛋，真正的意思是集體遇到麻煩時，個體也難以避開麻煩。
    對於當代人來說，全球化讓我們的生活更方便更自由，但也讓世界各地普遍產生聯繫。因此，我們可以說：“面對全球經濟危機，覆巢之下無完卵”。

sentences.simplified: 作为一种常见的食物，鸡蛋是人们餐桌上的常客。
sentences.traditional: 作為一種常見的食物，雞蛋是人們餐桌上的常客。

sentences.simplified: 与蛋相关的俗语在汉语中也是十分常见，“覆巢之下无完卵”就是其中之一。
sentences.traditional: 與蛋相關的俗語在漢語中也是十分常見，“覆巢之下無完卵”就是其中之一。
sentences.pinyin: yǔ dàn xiāng guān de sú yǔ zài hàn yǔ zhōng yě shì shí fēn cháng jiàn fù cháo zhī xià wú wán luǎn jiù shì qí zhōng zhī yī
sentences.english: As a common food, eggs are regular guests on people’s dining tables.
Egg-related proverbs are also very common in Chinese, and “there are no intact eggs under an overturned nest” is one of them.

sentences.traditional: 在東漢末年，權力逐漸落到了曹操手中。

sentences.traditional: 為此，很多人反對他、批評他，孔融就是反對派的重要代表之一。
sentences.pinyin: wèi cǐ hěn duō rén fǎn duì tā pī píng tā kǒng róng jiù shì fǎn duì pài de zhòng yào dài biǎo zhī yī
sentences.english: In the late Eastern Han Dynasty, power gradually fell into the hands of Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 曹操认为有人反对自己是很正常的事情，
sentences.traditional: 曹操認為有人反對自己是很正常的事情，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo rèn wéi yǒu rén fǎn duì zì jǐ shì hěn zhèng cháng de shì qing
sentences.english: For this reason, many people opposed and criticized him. Kong Rong was one of the important representatives of the opposition.

sentences.simplified: 而且他也希望人们看到自己宽容的样子，所以对孔融的批评表现得不太在意。
sentences.traditional: 而且他也希望人們看到自己寬容的樣子，所以對孔融的批評表現得不太在意。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě tā yě xī wàng rén men kàn dào zì jǐ kuān róng de yàng zi suǒ yǐ duì kǒng róng de pī píng biǎo xiàn de bú tài zài yì
sentences.english: Cao Cao thought it was normal for people to oppose him.

sentences.simplified: 孔融在当时很有影响力，但性格上有一个缺点——说话太直接，这让一些人很讨厌孔融。
sentences.traditional: 孔融在當時很有影響力，但性格上有一個缺點——說話太直接，這讓一些人很討厭孔融。
sentences.pinyin: kǒng róng zài dāng shí hěn yǒu yǐng xiǎng lì dàn xìng gé shang yǒu yí ge quē diǎn shuō huà tài zhí jiē zhè ràng yì xiē rén hěn tǎo yàn kǒng róng
sentences.english: He also wanted people to see that he was tolerant, so he didn’t seem to care much about Kong Rong’s criticism.

sentences.simplified: 一天，孔融在背后说了曹操的坏话，被一个讨厌孔融的人听到了。
sentences.traditional: 一天，孔融在背後說了曹操的壞話，被一個討厭孔融的人聽到了。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān kǒng róng zài bèi hòu shuō le cáo cāo de huài huà bèi yí ge tǎo yàn kǒng róng de rén tīng dào le
sentences.english: Kong Rong was very influential at the time, but he had a character flaw—he spoke too directly, which made some people dislike him.

sentences.simplified: 这个人就向曹操报告，还增加了一些难听的话，说孔融瞧不起曹操等等。
sentences.traditional: 這個人就向曹操報告，還增加了一些難聽的話，說孔融瞧不起曹操等等。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge rén jiù xiàng cáo cāo bào gào hái zēng jiā le yì xiē nán tīng de huà shuō kǒng róng qiáo bu qǐ cáo cāo děng děng
sentences.english: One day, Kong Rong spoke ill of Cao Cao behind his back but was overheard by someone who despised him.

sentences.simplified: 曹操听了大怒，下令杀掉孔融全家。
sentences.traditional: 曹操聽了大怒，下令殺掉孔融全家。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo tīng le dà nù xià lìng shā diào kǒng róng quán jiā
sentences.english: This person reported this to Cao Cao and added some unpleasant words, such as saying that Kong Rong looked down on Cao Cao.
Cao Cao was furious when he heard this and ordered the execution of Kong Rong’s entire family.

sentences.simplified: 很快，曹操的手下就来到孔融家抓人。
sentences.traditional: 很快，曹操的手下就來到孔融家抓人。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài cáo cāo de shǒu xià jiù lái dào kǒng róng jiā zhuā rén

sentences.simplified: 孔融的家人都害怕极了，求曹操放了他们。
sentences.traditional: 孔融的家人都害怕極了，求曹操放了他們。
sentences.pinyin: kǒng róng de jiā rén dōu hài pà jí le qiú cáo cāo fàng le tā men
sentences.english: Soon, Cao Cao’s men came to Kong Rong’s house to arrest him.

sentences.simplified: 只有孔融的两个孩子，一个八岁，一个九岁，
sentences.traditional: 只有孔融的兩個孩子，一個八歲，一個九歲，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu kǒng róng de liǎng ge hái zi yí ge bā suì yí ge jiǔ suì
sentences.english: Kong Rong’s family were absolutely terrified and begged Cao Cao to release them.

sentences.simplified: 还坐在那里下棋，一点害怕的样子都没有。
sentences.traditional: 還坐在那裡下棋，一點害怕的樣子都沒有。

sentences.english: Only Kong Rong’s two children, one 8 years old and the other 9 years old, ..

sentences.traditional: 大家以為孩子小，不懂事，就讓他們趕緊逃走，

sentences.english: .. were still sitting there playing chess, not looking afraid at all.

sentences.simplified: 但两个孩子还像没听到一样，继续下棋。

sentences.traditional: 孔融心疼極了，對曹操的人說：
sentences.pinyin: kǒng róng xīn téng jí le duì cáo cāo de rén shuō
sentences.english: However, the two children continued playing chess as if they hadn’t heard a thing.

sentences.simplified: “我的孩子还太小，只是我犯了错，能不能别杀这两个孩子？”
sentences.traditional: “我的孩子還太小，只是我犯了錯，能不能別殺這兩個孩子？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de hái zi hái tài xiǎo zhǐ shì wǒ fàn le cuò néng bù néng bié shā zhè liǎng ge hái zi
sentences.english: Kong Rong was very distressed and said to Cao Cao’s men, ..

sentences.simplified: 没想到，孔融的儿子慢慢走上前，平静地说：
sentences.traditional: 沒想到，孔融的兒子慢慢走上前，平靜地說：
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào kǒng róng de ér zi màn màn zǒu shàng qián píng jìng de shuō
sentences.english: .. “My children are still too young. It was only me who made the mistake. Can you not kill these two children?”

sentences.simplified: “父亲，您别求他了。您在翻倒的鸟窝下能看到完整的蛋吗？”
sentences.traditional: “父親，您別求他了。您在翻倒的鳥窩下能看到完整的蛋嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn nín bié qiú tā le nín zài fān dǎo de niǎo wō xià néng kàn dào wán zhěng de dàn ma
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, Kong Rong’s son slowly stepped forward and said calmly, ..

sentences.simplified: 大家听完都吃惊极了，原来这两个小孩什么都明白。
sentences.traditional: 大家聽完都吃驚極了，原來這兩個小孩什麼都明白。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā tīng wán dōu chī jīng jí le yuán lái zhè liǎng ge xiǎo hái shén me dōu míng bai
sentences.english: .. “Father, please don’t beg him anymore. Can you see intact eggs under an overturned bird’s nest?”
Everyone was shocked after hearing this. It turned out that these two children had understood everything.

sentences.simplified: 这就是“覆巢之下无完卵”的故事。
sentences.traditional: 這就是“覆巢之下無完卵”的故事。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì fù cháo zhī xià wú wán luǎn de gù shi

sentences.simplified: “覆巢”就是翻倒的鸟窝，“完卵”就是完整的蛋。
sentences.traditional: “覆巢”就是翻倒的鳥窩，“完卵”就是完整的蛋。
sentences.pinyin: fù cháo jiù shì fān dǎo de niǎo wō wán luǎn jiù shì wán zhěng de dàn
sentences.english: This is the story behind “there are no intact eggs under an overturned nest”.

sentences.simplified: 这一俗语的字面意思就是翻倒的鸟窝里不会有完整的蛋，
sentences.traditional: 這一俗語的字面意思就是翻倒的鳥窩裡不會有完整的蛋，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì sú yǔ de zì miàn yì si jiù shì fān dǎo de niǎo wō lǐ bú huì yǒu wán zhěng de dàn
sentences.english: “覆巢” means an overturned bird’s nest, and “完卵” means intact eggs.

sentences.simplified: 真正的意思是集体遇到麻烦时，个体也难以避开麻烦。
sentences.traditional: 真正的意思是集體遇到麻煩時，個體也難以避開麻煩。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn zhèng de yì si shì jí tǐ yù dào má fan shí gè tǐ yě nán yǐ bì kāi má fan
sentences.english: The literal meaning of this proverb is that there will be no intact eggs in an overturned bird’s nest.
The real meaning is that when the collective is in trouble, it is difficult for individuals to avoid trouble.

sentences.simplified: 对于当代人来说，全球化让我们的生活更方便更自由，

sentences.traditional: 但也讓世界各地普遍產生聯繫。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yě ràng shì jiè gè dì pǔ biàn chǎn shēng lián xì
sentences.english: For contemporary people, globalization has made our lives more convenient and freer.

sentences.simplified: 因此，我们可以说：“面对全球经济危机，覆巢之下无完卵”。
sentences.traditional: 因此，我們可以說：“面對全球經濟危機，覆巢之下無完卵”。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ wǒ men kě yǐ shuō miàn duì quán qiú jīng jì wēi jī fù cháo zhī xià wú wán luǎn
sentences.english: However, it has caused all regions of the world to become connected.

sentence_translations: There Are No Intact Eggs Under an Overturned Nest
As a common food, eggs are regular guests on people’s dining tables.
Egg-related proverbs are also very common in Chinese, and “there are no intact eggs under an overturned nest” is one of them.
In the late Eastern Han Dynasty, power gradually fell into the hands of Cao Cao.
For this reason, many people opposed and criticized him. Kong Rong was one of the important representatives of the opposition.
Cao Cao thought it was normal for people to oppose him.
He also wanted people to see that he was tolerant, so he didn’t seem to care much about Kong Rong’s criticism.
Kong Rong was very influential at the time, but he had a character flaw—he spoke too directly, which made some people dislike him.
One day, Kong Rong spoke ill of Cao Cao behind his back but was overheard by someone who despised him.
This person reported this to Cao Cao and added some unpleasant words, such as saying that Kong Rong looked down on Cao Cao.
Cao Cao was furious when he heard this and ordered the execution of Kong Rong’s entire family.
Soon, Cao Cao’s men came to Kong Rong’s house to arrest him.
Kong Rong’s family were absolutely terrified and begged Cao Cao to release them.
Only Kong Rong’s two children, one 8 years old and the other 9 years old, ..
.. were still sitting there playing chess, not looking afraid at all.
Everyone thought that the children were young and didn’t understand, and told them to run away quickly.
However, the two children continued playing chess as if they hadn’t heard a thing.
Kong Rong was very distressed and said to Cao Cao’s men, ..
.. “My children are still too young. It was only me who made the mistake. Can you not kill these two children?”
Unexpectedly, Kong Rong’s son slowly stepped forward and said calmly, ..
.. “Father, please don’t beg him anymore. Can you see intact eggs under an overturned bird’s nest?”
Everyone was shocked after hearing this. It turned out that these two children had understood everything.
This is the story behind “there are no intact eggs under an overturned nest”.
“覆巢” means an overturned bird’s nest, and “完卵” means intact eggs.
The literal meaning of this proverb is that there will be no intact eggs in an overturned bird’s nest.
The real meaning is that when the collective is in trouble, it is difficult for individuals to avoid trouble.
For contemporary people, globalization has made our lives more convenient and freer.
However, it has caused all regions of the world to become connected.
Therefore, we can say: “In the face of a global economic crisis, there are no intact eggs under an overturned nest.”
